comment: Grammatical but marked: adjunct after the closed verb bracket (kehrt ... zurück nach einer Pause); unit 9 still reads acceptably in German.

'becomes very sharp' vs 'verschärft sich deutlich' (sharpens markedly): same event in context.

Tail -> camel OK, no leak.

'senkt seine Netze' understandable (fishermen usually 'lassen die Netze ins Wasser').

'anticipate' vs 'freuen sich auf' (look forward to): slight affective shift, same expectation; acceptable.

Tail -> traffic OK.
US spelling 'neighbor' (other families use UK spelling); consistent within the family.
